verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a plain C/C++ runtime with no dependencies. It ships command-line entry points (`llama cli`, `llama serve`), pre-built binaries and Docker images, so it runs headlessly on servers, and the web UI is an optional add-on to the server. Community users report driving it from the terminal (e.g. llama-mtmd-cli). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of use in CI pipelines.
